title: Future updates
patterns: do i have to pay again for updates
response: Future updates are included at no extra cost. New installer versions come through the built-in updater, and when we refresh the package itself you can re-download it from your access e-mail.

title: Recovering your access
patterns: how do i recover my access
the link is not working anymore
response: Email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} with the e-mail address you used at checkout, or a copy of the receipt. We will resend the download links and access details.
followup: Anything else I can help with?

title: Downloading more than once
patterns: how many times can i download
response: Download as many times as you need — there is no limit. New laptop, reinstalled Windows, or a corrupted copy on the drive: just grab the package again from your email link.
followup: Anything else about accessing your files?

title: How updates reach you
patterns: how do i get the new versions
how do i refresh my installers
how do i update the programs on the usb
response: Open the updater inside the toolkit. It lists each application with its last update date and the target folder, and lets you download the newest installer into the right place on your drive, with one click per program.
followup: Do you want the tutorial link?
